english: take a turn for the worse

terms.comment: Built on Tacitus’ in dēterius, for the worse (cūncta aucta in dēterius, Tac. A. 2.82, Lewis & Short s.v. dēterior). Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.

sources: Lewis & Short: deterior · Lewis & Short: inclino
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 66, 399, checked against the searchable text of the book.
